source_refs.title: Add or move contacts
source_refs.applicability: Android phones with the Contacts app
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Contacts saved to your Google Account sync with Google Contacts and your Android devices.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android: Open the Contacts app on your Android device. At the bottom right, tap the Add icon. Enter the contact's name and an email address or phone number. To add more name details, tap Add fields, then tap the field type you want. To add a photo, tap Add picture at the top, capture or select a picture, then tap Choose. When you're finished, tap Save. Contacts saved to your Google Account sync with Google Contacts and your Android devices.

source_refs.applicability: Google Contacts used in a web browser on a computer

source_refs.model_visible_text: On a computer: Open Google Contacts in a browser. At the top left, click Create contact. Choose Create a contact or Create multiple contacts. Enter the information and click Save.
